# Dual-Card Connector Apparatus

The apparatus is designed to accommodate two different cards of varying sizes, such as a SIM card and a memory card, within a single integrated system. This versatile design allows a single device to interface with multiple card types, enhancing functionality while conserving space.

## Connector Configuration

At the core of the apparatus is a connector featuring two key components: a first portion and a second portion. These portions are engineered to be manipulated into two distinct orientations, providing flexibility in how the cards are received and utilized.

### First Orientation

In the first orientation, the connector's portions are positioned to removably receive either the first card or the second card independently. This configuration allows each card to be inserted and removed separately, offering the user convenient access to either card as needed.

### Second Orientation

In the second orientation, the first card is stacked together with the second card, allowing both to be removably inserted into the device simultaneously. This stacked arrangement optimizes the use of available space and streamlines the insertion process when both cards are required at once.

## Electrical Communication

Beyond its mechanical versatility, the design enables reliable electrical communication between the device and each card. When a respective card is received in its corresponding connector portion, the apparatus establishes the necessary electrical connections, ensuring that the device can properly read from and interact with each card according to its function.

This dual-orientation approach delivers a compact, adaptable solution for devices requiring support for multiple card formats, balancing convenience, efficiency, and functional reliability.

# Dual-Orientation Connector for Accommodating Multiple Card Types

## Field of the Invention

The present disclosure relates generally to connectors for electronic devices, and more particularly to a dual-orientation connector configured to receive and accommodate multiple cards of differing physical dimensions, such as a subscriber identity module (SIM) card and a memory card, within a single integrated assembly.

## Background

Modern portable electronic devices, including smartphones, tablets, and other mobile computing platforms, frequently require simultaneous access to more than one type of removable card. A SIM card, for example, enables cellular network connectivity by storing subscriber and authentication information, while a memory card provides expandable data storage. Historically, these cards have required separate dedicated slots, each occupying valuable interior space within an increasingly compact device chassis. As devices continue to shrink in size while demanding greater functionality, there exists a need for a connector arrangement capable of efficiently accommodating multiple cards of different sizes without unnecessarily consuming internal volume.

## Summary of the Invention

An apparatus and method are described for a dual-orientation connector having two distinct portions, each designed to accommodate a card of a different size. In one representative embodiment, a first portion is dimensioned to receive a first card, such as a SIM card, while a second portion is dimensioned to receive a second card, such as a memory card, the two cards differing in one or more physical dimensions including length, width, or thickness.

The connector is configurable between at least two orientations. In a **first orientation**, the connector presents the first and second portions such that each card may be individually and independently received, allowing a user to insert or remove either card without disturbing the other. In a **second orientation**, the connector is manipulated so that the received cards are arranged in a stacked configuration, thereby reducing the overall footprint required for insertion of both cards into the host device.

When the connector, bearing one or both cards in the stacked configuration, is inserted into the corresponding receptacle of the electronic device, electrical communication is established between the device and each respectively received card. Conductive contacts within the connector are arranged to independently interface with the contact pads of each card, ensuring that signals and power are routed appropriately to and from the SIM card and the memory card without cross-interference.

## Detailed Description

In operation, the connector may take the form of a tray, sled, or frame that is at least partially removable from the host device. The first portion and the second portion may be defined by respective recesses, walls, or seating surfaces shaped to conform to the profile of the intended card. Because the cards differ in size, the seating features prevent improper insertion and provide positive retention of each card in its designated position.

The transition between the first orientation and the second orientation may be accomplished through a variety of mechanisms. In certain embodiments, the two portions are hinged, pivoted, folded, or slidably coupled such that moving from the individual-receiving orientation to the stacked orientation brings the cards into overlapping planes. In other embodiments, the reorientation is achieved by rotating or flipping one portion relative to the other. This manipulation allows the cards, which are received in a spread or side-by-side arrangement for ease of loading, to be consolidated into a compact stack suitable for insertion.

The electrical interface may include a plurality of resilient contacts, spring fingers, or pads positioned to align with the terminals of each card once the cards are seated and the connector is placed in the stacked orientation. This arrangement enables the host device to simultaneously communicate with both cards—for example, drawing subscriber credentials from the SIM card while reading from or writing to the memory card—through a single connector interface.

## Advantages

By combining the receptacles for two differently sized cards into a single dual-orientation connector, the described apparatus conserves interior space within the host device, simplifies the user's insertion and removal experience, and reduces the number of discrete openings required in the device housing. The ability to load each card individually in one orientation, and then stack the cards for compact insertion in another orientation, provides both convenience and mechanical efficiency while maintaining reliable, independent electrical communication with each card.

## Method of Use

A corresponding method includes: providing a dual-orientation connector having a first portion and a second portion; receiving a first card in the first portion and a second card in the second portion while the connector is in the first orientation; manipulating the connector into the second orientation to stack the first and second cards; inserting the stacked connector into a receptacle of an electronic device; and establishing electrical communication between the device and each of the first and second cards.

# The Convenience of an Included SIM Card

When purchasing a new mobile device or signing up for a phone plan, one of the most convenient features to look for is an **included SIM card**. Gone are the days when customers had to visit a store separately to obtain their SIM, activate it, and configure their settings manually. Today, many providers streamline the entire process by bundling everything together.

## What Does "Included" Really Mean?

**The** term "included" typically refers to a **SIM** card that comes packaged directly with your device or service plan at no additional cost. This means that when you open your new phone box, you'll find the SIM already inside, ready to be inserted and activated. For many consumers, this eliminates unnecessary steps and reduces the frustration of setting up a new connection.

## Benefits of an Included SIM

There are several advantages to having **the SIM** already provided:

- **Convenience:** No need to shop around for a separate SIM card.
- **Cost savings:** Often, the SIM is offered free of charge as part of the package.
- **Time efficiency:** Activation is usually quicker when everything comes from one provider.
- **Compatibility:** An **included SIM** is guaranteed to work with the device it comes with.

## Making the Most of Your Plan

Before choosing a plan, it's wise to check whether a **SIM** is **included** and what type of network access it provides. **The** best deals often combine a device, a SIM card, and a data plan into a single, straightforward package.

In conclusion, an **included SIM** card offers a hassle-free way to get connected, making it an appealing option for anyone seeking simplicity and value.

## Dual-Function Connector Apparatus for Shared SIM and Memory Card Interface in Mobile Devices

An apparatus is disclosed that enables a Subscriber Identity Module (SIM) card and a memory card to share a single physical connector within a mobile device, thereby reducing the spatial footprint required for card interfaces. The apparatus comprises a unified connector assembly having a plurality of electrical contacts configured to selectively interface with either a SIM card or a memory card. A detection module identifies the type of card inserted into the connector based on physical characteristics, electrical signatures, or communication protocols. A switching circuit, responsive to the detection module, dynamically reconfigures the electrical contacts and routes signals to an appropriate controller—either a SIM controller for authentication and network identification functions or a memory controller for data storage operations. In certain embodiments, the connector includes a mechanical guide structure accommodating the differing form factors of both card types, and a multiplexer selectively couples the shared contacts to the corresponding processing circuitry. The apparatus thereby permits a single insertion slot to serve dual functions, conserving internal device space, reducing manufacturing costs, and providing enhanced flexibility for the end user in configuring the mobile device according to individual connectivity and storage requirements.

# ABSTRACT

A repositionable connector assembly for selectively accommodating both a subscriber identity module (SIM) card and a memory card is disclosed. The connector assembly comprises a housing defining a card-receiving cavity, a plurality of electrically conductive terminals disposed within said housing, and a repositionable retention mechanism operatively coupled to said housing and configured to transition between a first operative position and a second operative position. In the first operative position, said retention mechanism is adapted to secure a subscriber identity module card in electrical communication with a first subset of said conductive terminals. In the second operative position, said retention mechanism is adapted to secure a memory card in electrical communication with a second subset of said conductive terminals. The connector assembly further includes a biasing element configured to maintain said retention mechanism in a selected one of said operative positions and to resist inadvertent displacement therefrom. By virtue of the repositionable retention mechanism, a single connector assembly may selectively receive and retain either card type, thereby reducing the number of discrete connectors required within a host device and conserving space upon a circuit substrate. The disclosed invention provides enhanced modularity, reduced component count, and improved spatial efficiency in electronic devices requiring interchangeable card functionality.

A card adapter device and method for enabling electrical communication between two differently sized cards and an electronic device.
